rules.authority: Nghị định 293/2025/NĐ-CP art.3: monthly and hourly minimum wages by region from 1 January 2026; an hourly-paid worker is held to the hourly column. Decree 74/2024 art.4 (December 2025) and Decree 293/2025 art.4 (2026 onward): minimum wages govern wage agreements and payment; weekly wages convert at 52/12. Art.4(3): weekly and daily wages may satisfy either the monthly or the hourly minimum after conversion using lawful normal working time.
rules.prior_authority: Decree 293/2025/NĐ-CP art.5(5): where an area moved to a lower region from 1 January 2026, an employee hired on or before 31 December 2025 keeps the Decree 74/2024 minimum of the prior region until the Government provides otherwise.

rules.description: Register each employee for compulsory social, health and unemployment insurance with Vietnam Social Security (the SI book is issued on it). When: An employee becomes a compulsory participant: a labour contract of one month or more; a foreigner on a contract of twelve months or more. Due: Within 30 days of the day the employee becomes a compulsory participant.
rules.authority: Law on Social Insurance 41/2024/QH15 arts.13(1), 28(1) https://xaydungchinhsach.chinhphu.vn/toan-van-luat-so-41-2024-qh15-bao-hiem-xa-hoi-119240723163650489.htm; Law on Employment 74/2025/QH15 art.32(1): UI registration is made together with the compulsory SI registration https://xaydungchinhsach.chinhphu.vn/toan-van-luat-viec-lam-119250711173403835.htm

rules.description: Declare changes to a participant's registration: salary changes, suspension for 14 or more unpaid working days, departure. When: A change in the registered information or in the contribution status. Due: When the change occurs, before the month's contribution is settled.
rules.authority: Law 41/2024/QH15 arts.29(1), 33(5), 34(3) https://xaydungchinhsach.chinhphu.vn/toan-van-luat-so-41-2024-qh15-bao-hiem-xa-hoi-119240723163650489.htm

rules.description: Deduct the employee shares of SI, HI and UI from the salary and remit them with the employer shares; late payment carries 0.03% a day. The engine computes the employee and employer SI, HI and UI shares on each payslip; the remittance is outside it. When: Each contribution month. Due: By the last day of the month following the contribution month.
rules.authority: Law 41/2024/QH15 arts.13(4), 34(4)(a), 40(1) https://xaydungchinhsach.chinhphu.vn/toan-van-luat-so-41-2024-qh15-bao-hiem-xa-hoi-119240723163650489.htm; Law 74/2025/QH15 art.33(2)–(3): UI is paid at the time SI is paid https://xaydungchinhsach.chinhphu.vn/toan-van-luat-viec-lam-119250711173403835.htm

rules.description: Compile sickness and maternity benefit claims for Vietnam Social Security; the fund, not payroll, pays the benefit. When: An employee returns from fund-paid sickness or maternity leave and hands in the claim file (within 45 days). Due: Within 7 working days of receiving the complete file from the employee. Engine: raised when a sick, maternity or paternity entry is recorded, due 7 working days after the leave ends (the earliest the file can be complete: never later than the law).
rules.authority: Law 41/2024/QH15 arts.13(2), 48(1)–(2), 62(1) https://xaydungchinhsach.chinhphu.vn/toan-van-luat-so-41-2024-qh15-bao-hiem-xa-hoi-119240723163650489.htm
rules.due: add_working_days(has(row.to) && row.to != null ? row.to : today, 7, holidays)

rules.description: Pay an employee outside compulsory SI, HI and UI an amount equal to the employer's contributions with each wage. Engine: the INSURANCE_EQUIVALENT allowance class prices it each month once HR raises the standing row. When: An employee who is not a compulsory participant. Due: With each wage payment.
rules.authority: Labour Code 2019 art.168(3) https://congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn/CongBaoCP/VanBan/2019/11/30232/29070-1-2019993-99445-2019-qh14.pdf

rules.description: Conclude a written labour contract, in two copies, with the content art.21 requires, before the employee starts work. When: Hiring for work of one month or more. Due: Before the employee starts work.
rules.authority: Labour Code 2019 arts.13(2), 14(1), 21(1) https://congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn/CongBaoCP/VanBan/2019/11/30232/29070-1-2019993-99445-2019-qh14.pdf

rules.description: Keep the labour management book (paper or electronic) and produce it to the authorities on request. When: Each employee from the day work starts. Due: From the first day of work, updated on every change.
rules.authority: Labour Code 2019 art.12(1); Decree 145/2020/NĐ-CP art.3 https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2020/12/145.signed.pdf

rules.description: Declare the use of labour on starting operations and report changes in labour to the provincial labour authority, notifying Social Security. When: Start of operations; each half-year and year. Due: Declaration within 30 days of starting operations; half-yearly report before 5 June and annual report before 5 December (form 01/PLI, National Public Service Portal).
rules.authority: Labour Code 2019 art.12(2) https://congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn/CongBaoCP/VanBan/2019/11/30232/29070-1-2019993-99445-2019-qh14.pdf; Decree 145/2020/NĐ-CP art.4(1)–(2) https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2020/12/145.signed.pdf

rules.description: Issue written internal labour rules and register them with the provincial labour authority. When: An employer using 10 or more employees. Due: File the registration within 10 days of issuing the rules. Engine: raised each December while the entity has 10 or more contracts in force.
rules.authority: Labour Code 2019 arts.118, 119(1)–(2) https://congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn/CongBaoCP/VanBan/2019/11/30232/29070-1-2019993-99445-2019-qh14.pdf

rules.description: Build the salary scale, pay table and labour norms, consult the employee representative organisation, and post them at the workplace. When: Before applying a salary scale or a change to it. Due: Published at the workplace before implementation.
rules.authority: Labour Code 2019 art.93 https://congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn/CongBaoCP/VanBan/2019/11/30232/29070-1-2019993-99445-2019-qh14.pdf

rules.description: Pay a covered employee at least the regional minimum wage — monthly for monthly-paid work, hourly for hourly-paid work. Engine: the run warns on a contract below the monthly regional table; hourly-paid and part-time contracts are not compared with the hourly minimum. When: Each wage agreement and payment. Due: Continuously; the version's regional table.
rules.authority: Labour Code 2019 art.91; Decree 293/2025/NĐ-CP from 1 January 2026 (5,310,000 / 4,730,000 / 4,140,000 / 3,700,000 a month; 25,500 / 22,700 / 20,000 / 17,800 an hour) https://xaydungchinhsach.chinhphu.vn/nghi-dinh-so-293-2025-nd-cp-quy-dinh-muc-luong-toi-thieu-doi-voi-nguoi-lao-dong-lam-viec-theo-hop-dong-lao-dong-119251110172808433.htm

rules.description: Pay wages directly, in full and on time: monthly or half-monthly on a fixed periodic date; hourly, daily or weekly wages at most every 15 days. Engine: the run pays on the operator's pay date; periodicity and the late-payment interest are not checked. When: Each pay period. Due: On the agreed periodic date; a delay caused by force majeure may not exceed 30 days, and a delay of 15 days or more owes interest at the bank's one-month deposit rate.
rules.authority: Labour Code 2019 arts.94(1), 97 https://congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn/CongBaoCP/VanBan/2019/11/30232/29070-1-2019993-99445-2019-qh14.pdf

rules.description: Give the employee a wage statement at every payment showing the salary, overtime pay, night pay and each deduction with its amount. Engine: the payslip carries the salary, overtime, night-premium and deduction lines. When: Each wage payment. Due: At each payment.
rules.authority: Labour Code 2019 art.95(3) https://congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn/CongBaoCP/VanBan/2019/11/30232/29070-1-2019993-99445-2019-qh14.pdf

rules.description: Deduct from wages only to compensate damage to the employer's tools, equipment or property, tell the employee why, and keep the monthly deduction within 30% of the wage actually paid after SI, HI, UI and PIT. rules.authority: Labour Code 2019 arts.102, 129 https://congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn/CongBaoCP/VanBan/2019/11/30232/29070-1-2019993-99445-2019-qh14.pdf

rules.description: Obtain the employee's consent to overtime and keep it within 50% of the normal day (12 hours in total under a weekly regime), 40 hours a month and 200 hours a year (300 in the listed sectors and cases); notify the provincial labour authority in writing when organising overtime above 200 hours. Engine: the daily, monthly and yearly limits are work-rule warnings; consent and the notice are not recorded. When: Any overtime; overtime above 200 hours a year. rules.authority: Labour Code 2019 art.107(2)–(4) https://congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn/CongBaoCP/VanBan/2019/11/30232/29070-1-2019993-99445-2019-qh14.pdf; Decree 145/2020/NĐ-CP arts.59–62 https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2020/12/145.signed.pdf

rules.description: Keep a statement of the night and overtime hours worked and the pay for them, to support the PIT exemption, and produce it to the tax authority on request. Engine: the payslip lines carry each day's overtime and night hours and amounts; a separate statement is not produced. When: Night work or overtime paid. Due: Kept with the payroll records for each period.
rules.authority: Decree 253/2026/NĐ-CP art.26(1) paragraph 2, applied to resident salary income from tax year 2026 by art.69(1)(a) https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2026/7/253m-ndcp.signed.pdf

rules.description: Set the annual-leave schedule after consulting employees and notify it in advance; pay untaken leave on termination. Engine: untaken leave is encashed on exit; the schedule is outside. When: Each leave year; termination with untaken leave. Due: Schedule notified before the leave; untaken leave paid with the final settlement.
rules.authority: Labour Code 2019 art.113(3)–(4) https://congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn/CongBaoCP/VanBan/2019/11/30232/29070-1-2019993-99445-2019-qh14.pdf; Decree 145/2020/NĐ-CP art.67 https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2020/12/145.signed.pdf

rules.description: Hold workplace dialogue with employees or their representative organisation. When: Periodically; on request; on the art.63(2)(c) events (restructuring, pay scale, bonus rules, internal rules). Due: At least once a year, and when an art.63(2)(b)–(c) event arises.
rules.authority: Labour Code 2019 art.63(2) https://congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn/CongBaoCP/VanBan/2019/11/30232/29070-1-2019993-99445-2019-qh14.pdf

rules.description: Give written notice of the end of a labour contract, and the notice period for an employer's unilateral termination. When: The contract ends (other than art.34(4)–(8)); a unilateral termination under art.36(1)(a), (b), (c), (đ), (g). Due: Notice at least 45 days (indefinite contract), 30 days (12–36 months), 3 working days (under 12 months, or long illness).
rules.authority: Labour Code 2019 arts.36(2), 45(1) https://congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn/CongBaoCP/VanBan/2019/11/30232/29070-1-2019993-99445-2019-qh14.pdf
rules.when: contract != null && contract.exit_facts != null && contract.effective_range.to != null

rules.description: Where restructuring, technological change or economic reasons affect many employees, adopt a labour-use plan, consult the representative organisation and notify before dismissal. When: Dismissals for restructuring, technology or economic reasons (art.42), or on a merger, division or sale (art.43). Due: 30 days' notice to the provincial People's Committee and to the employees before the dismissals.
rules.authority: Labour Code 2019 arts.42(3)–(6), 44 https://congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn/CongBaoCP/VanBan/2019/11/30232/29070-1-2019993-99445-2019-qh14.pdf
rules.when: contract != null && contract.exit_facts != null && contract.effective_range.to != null

rules.description: Settle every amount due to the leaver: final wages, untaken leave, severance or job-loss allowance. Engine: the run prices final pay, encashment and the separation allowances and warns when paid after final_pay_deadlines. When: Termination of the labour contract. Due: Within 14 working days of termination; up to 30 days in the cases of art.48(1)(a)–(d).
rules.authority: Labour Code 2019 arts.46, 47, 48(1) https://congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn/CongBaoCP/VanBan/2019/11/30232/29070-1-2019993-99445-2019-qh14.pdf; Decree 145/2020/NĐ-CP art.8 https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2020/12/145.signed.pdf
rules.when: contract != null && contract.exit_facts != null && contract.effective_range.to != null

rules.description: Complete the confirmation of the SI and UI contribution periods and return the SI book and any original documents held; provide copies of work records on request. When: Termination of the labour contract. Due: Within the art.48(1) settlement period.
rules.authority: Labour Code 2019 art.48(3) https://congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn/CongBaoCP/VanBan/2019/11/30232/29070-1-2019993-99445-2019-qh14.pdf; Law 41/2024/QH15 art.13(3) https://xaydungchinhsach.chinhphu.vn/toan-van-luat-so-41-2024-qh15-bao-hiem-xa-hoi-119240723163650489.htm
rules.when: contract != null && contract.exit_facts != null && contract.effective_range.to != null

rules.description: Register the tax code of an employee without one, and the dependants the employee declares for family deduction, on the employee's authorisation. When: First salary payment to an employee without a tax code; a dependant declaration. Due: Within 10 working days of the tax obligation arising.
rules.authority: Law 38/2019/QH14 art.33: the income payer registers tax on behalf of an employee (and the dependants the employee declares) within 10 working days of the obligation arising; Circular 86/2024/TT-BTC: the personal identification number is the tax code from 1 July 2025

rules.description: Declare and pay the PIT withheld from salaries (form 05/KK-TNCN). Engine: the monthly withholding is computed; the declaration and payment are outside. When: Each month (or quarter) in which PIT was withheld. Due: Monthly by the 20th of the following month, or quarterly by the last day of the first month of the following quarter; payment by the same day.
rules.authority: Law on Tax Administration 38/2019/QH14 art.44(1)(a)–(b) (monthly by the 20th of the next month; quarterly by the last day of the first month of the next quarter), art.55(1) (payment by the filing deadline), art.59 (late-payment interest 0.03% a day); Decree 126/2020/NĐ-CP arts.8(1), 9 (monthly, or quarterly for an employer eligible to file VAT quarterly)

rules.description: Keep the employee's commitment form (08/CK-TNCN) that suspends the 10% withholding on a contract under three months, and report the income in the finalisation. Engine: the PIT `commitment_form` election suspends the 10% rule; the signed form is kept outside. When: A resident on no contract or a contract under three months who expects income below the taxable threshold. Due: Before the payment that is not withheld.
rules.authority: Decree 253/2026/NĐ-CP art.50(2) https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2026/7/253m-ndcp.signed.pdf

rules.description: File the employer's annual PIT finalisation (05/QTT-TNCN with its schedules), finalising on behalf of each employee who authorises it. Engine: the last-of-year rule trues up the year's withholding on the annual table; the authorisation and the filing are outside. When: End of the tax year. Due: By the last day of the third month after the tax year (31 March).
rules.authority: Law 38/2019/QH14 art.44(2)(a): an organisation's annual finalisation by the last day of the third month after the calendar year; Decree 126/2020/NĐ-CP art.8(6)(d): finalisation on behalf of an employee on a contract of three months or more who authorises it

rules.description: Issue the employee a PIT withholding certificate for the tax withheld. When: The employee requests it; an employee who has not authorised the employer to finalise. Due: On request.
rules.authority: Decree 123/2020/NĐ-CP arts.31–32 as amended by Decree 70/2025/NĐ-CP (electronic withholding certificates)
rules.when: contract != null && contract.exit_facts != null && contract.effective_range.to != null

rules.description: Pay the trade union fee (kinh phí công đoàn) of 2% of the SI salary fund, whether or not a grassroots union exists. Engine: an agricultural, forestry, fishery or salt employer registered for the three-monthly mode (entity fact union_fee_quarterly) pays each month’s fee by the last day of the month after its quarter (Decree 105/2026 art.4(1)(b), (2)(b)); the cycle is read as the calendar quarter.
rules.authority: Law on Trade Unions 50/2024/QH15 art.29(1)(b), (2) https://xaydungchinhsach.chinhphu.vn/toan-van-luat-cong-doan-119241217155547243.htm; Decree 105/2026/NĐ-CP art.4 https://vanban.chinhphu.vn/?docid=217500&pageid=27160

rules.description: Deduct the dues of union members who so authorise and transfer them to the grassroots union: 0.5% of the SI salary, capped at 10% of the base salary. Engine: UNION_DUES deducts the dues where the `union_member` election is true; the transfer is outside. When: A union member on payroll. Due: Each month.
rules.authority: Law on Trade Unions 50/2024/QH15 art.29(1)(a) https://xaydungchinhsach.chinhphu.vn/toan-van-luat-cong-doan-119241217155547243.htm; Quyết định 61/QĐ-TLĐ, in force 1 July 2025 https://pbgdpl.cantho.gov.vn/quyet-dinh-61qd-tld-ve-dieu-chinh-giam-muc-dong-doan-phi-cong-doan

rules.description: Obtain a work permit (with the integrated approval of the demand for foreign labour) or a certificate of exemption before a foreign employee starts work; the contract term may not exceed the permit. When: Hiring or extending a foreign employee. Due: Before the employee starts work; renewal before the permit expires.
rules.authority: Labour Code 2019 arts.151–155 https://congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn/CongBaoCP/VanBan/2019/11/30232/29070-1-2019993-99445-2019-qh14.pdf; Decree 219/2025/NĐ-CP (in force 7 August 2025) https://vanban.chinhphu.vn/?pageid=27160&docid=214840

rules.description: Arrange periodic health checks for employees. When: Each year; every six months for heavy, hazardous or dangerous work, minors, the disabled and the elderly. Due: At least once a year (twice for the listed groups).
rules.authority: Law on Occupational Safety and Hygiene 84/2015/QH13 art.21(1)

rules.description: Retain payroll sheets, timesheets and supporting accounting documents according to their accounting use; protect employee personal data under the data-protection law. When: Each payroll period. Due: Archive within 12 months after the accounting year or accounting task ends. Retain documents used directly for bookkeeping and financial statements at least 10 years; management-only accounting documents at least 5 years, measured from accounting year end.
rules.authority: Accounting Law 88/2015/QH13 art.41(3),(5)(a)-(b); Decree 174/2016/NĐ-CP arts.12(1)-(2), 13(1), 15(1); Law on Personal Data Protection 91/2025/QH15, in force 1 January 2026

rules.description: Process an employee's personal data only with their consent, given voluntarily, informed of the data types, purpose, controller and rights, expressed in a verifiable form (written or electronic), for each purpose separately; silence is not consent; consent may be withdrawn or processing restricted on request. Processing without consent is limited to the cases in art.19. When: Collection or processing of a candidate's or employee's personal data. Due: Before processing
rules.authority: Law on Personal Data Protection 91/2025/QH15 arts.9, 10, 19 (in force 1 January 2026, art.38(1)) (https://bocongan.gov.vn/chinh-sach-phap-luat/co-so-du-lieu-van-ban/luat-bao-ve-du-lieu-ca-nhan-1753688803); Decree 356/2025/NĐ-CP (https://vanban.chinhphu.vn/?pageid=27160&docid=216387); consents given under Decree 13/2023 remain valid (art.39(1))

rules.description: Request from candidates only information that serves recruitment and use it only for that purpose (with consent); delete a rejected candidate's data unless agreed otherwise; keep employee data for the period set by law or agreement; delete it when the contract ends unless law or agreement requires otherwise; use technical monitoring of employees only where lawful and made known to them. When: Recruitment, employment, contract termination, or technical monitoring of employees. Due: Candidate data: on the recruitment decision; employee data: on termination, subject to statutory retention
rules.authority: Law on Personal Data Protection 91/2025/QH15 art.25 (https://bocongan.gov.vn/chinh-sach-phap-luat/co-so-du-lieu-van-ban/luat-bao-ve-du-lieu-ca-nhan-1753688803)
rules.when: contract != null && contract.exit_facts != null && contract.effective_range.to != null

rules.description: Prepare and keep a personal data processing impact assessment dossier and send one original to the specialised personal data protection agency (Ministry of Public Security); update it every 6 months when it changes, or immediately on reorganisation, a change of the data-protection service provider, or a change of business lines related to processing. A cross-border transfer impact assessment is also required, except for storing employees' data on cloud services (art.20(6)(b)). Small enterprises and startups may opt out for 5 years from 1 January 2026, and household businesses and micro-enterprises are exempt, unless they process sensitive or large-volume data. When: Start of personal data processing (and any cross-border transfer). Due: Within 60 days from the start of processing; updates as stated
rules.authority: Law on Personal Data Protection 91/2025/QH15 arts.20, 21, 22, 38(2)–(3), 39(2) (https://bocongan.gov.vn/chinh-sach-phap-luat/co-so-du-lieu-van-ban/luat-bao-ve-du-lieu-ca-nhan-1753688803); Decree 356/2025/NĐ-CP (https://vanban.chinhphu.vn/?pageid=27160&docid=216387)

rules.description: On discovering a violation of personal data protection rules that may harm national defence, security or social order, or infringe the life, health, honour, dignity or property of data subjects, notify the specialised personal data protection agency and record the violation in minutes; a processor that discovers a violation must promptly inform the controller. Decree 356/2025 adds notice to data subjects for location and biometric data. When: Discovery of a personal data protection violation. Due: No later than 72 hours from discovery
rules.authority: Law on Personal Data Protection 91/2025/QH15 art.23 (https://bocongan.gov.vn/chinh-sach-phap-luat/co-so-du-lieu-van-ban/luat-bao-ve-du-lieu-ca-nhan-1753688803); Decree 356/2025/NĐ-CP (https://vanban.chinhphu.vn/?pageid=27160&docid=216387)

rules.description: Designate a department or personnel qualified in personal data protection, or engage a licensed personal data protection service provider. Small enterprises and startups may opt out for 5 years from 1 January 2026, and household businesses and micro-enterprises are exempt, unless they process sensitive or large-volume data. When: The employer processes personal data. Due: Continuous
rules.authority: Law on Personal Data Protection 91/2025/QH15 arts.33(2), 38(2)–(3) (https://bocongan.gov.vn/chinh-sach-phap-luat/co-so-du-lieu-van-ban/luat-bao-ve-du-lieu-ca-nhan-1753688803)
Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.105(1)–(2): normal hours at most 8 a day and 48 a week; Decree 145/2020/NĐ-CP arts.54(1)(a3)–(a4), 55(1)(a). The fallback is used only where the entity plans no shifts.
Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.106: night work is counted from 22:00 to 06:00 the next morning.

rules.description: Declare the use of labour to the provincial labour authority on starting operations (through the business-registration procedure of Decree 122/2020).
rules.authority: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.12(2): within 30 days of starting operations; Decree 145/2020/NĐ-CP art.4(1). Engine: raised when the entity is created, due 30 days from the first day of that month (never later than the law).

rules.description: A monthly wage for the job below the regional minimum wage of the entity’s region.
rules.when: !(terms.employment_type in ["PART_TIME", "PROBATION", "INTERN"]) && terms.base_salary > 0.0 && terms.base_salary < max(double(rules.minimum_wage.by_region[company.region in ["I", "II", "III"] ? company.region : "IV"]), (has(terms.facts.prior_floor_reclassified) && terms.facts.prior_floor_reclassified == true && has(terms.facts.prior_floor_region) && employment.start_date != "" && employment.start_date <= "2025-12-31") ? double(rules.minimum_wage.prior_by_region[terms.facts.prior_floor_region]) : 0.0)
rules.message: The monthly wage is below the regional minimum wage for the entity’s region (Labour Code art.90(2), art.91).
rules.authority: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 arts.90(2), 91 https://congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn/CongBaoCP/VanBan/2019/11/30232/29070-1-2019993-99445-2019-qh14.pdf; Decree 293/2025/NĐ-CP art.3 (the version’s rules.minimum_wage.by_region). An entity without a recorded region is checked against Region IV, the lowest floor; part-time, probation (at least 85% of the job wage, art.26) and intern terms are outside the monthly check. An incumbent hired by 31 December 2025 whose worksite moved to a lower region keeps the prior region’s Decree 74/2024 minimum (Decree 293/2025 art.5(5); contract-term facts prior_floor_region, prior_floor_reclassified).

rules.description: Overtime above 40 hours in the month.
rules.when: sum(work.days.map(d, (work.holidays.exists(h, h.date == d.date && h.kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE", "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY"] && (h.given_to != "ONLY_IF_OFF_ON_REPLACED_DATE" || (h.replaces != "" && !(h.replaces in work.dates)))) || d.day_type in ["REST", "OFF"]) ? (d.worked_hours > 0.0 ? d.worked_hours : d.overtime_hours) : d.overtime_hours)) > 40.0
rules.message: overtime exceeds 40 hours in the month (Labour Code art.107(2)(b)).
rules.authority: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.107(2)(b): overtime may not exceed 40 hours a month https://congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn/CongBaoCP/VanBan/2019/11/30232/29070-1-2019993-99445-2019-qh14.pdf. Counted: approved overtime on working days, and every hour worked on a rest day or public holiday.

rules.description: Overtime above half the normal hours of a day, or a day above 12 hours under the weekly regime.
rules.when: (has(terms.facts.normal_hours_arrangement) && terms.facts.normal_hours_arrangement == "WEEKLY") ? work.days.exists(d, d.scheduled_hours + d.overtime_hours > 12.0) : work.days.exists(d, d.scheduled_hours > 0.0 && d.overtime_hours > 0.5 * d.scheduled_hours)
rules.message: a day’s overtime exceeds the daily limit (Labour Code art.107(2)(a)).
rules.authority: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.107(2)(a): overtime at most 50% of the normal hours of a day; under a weekly regime normal plus overtime hours at most 12 a day https://congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn/CongBaoCP/VanBan/2019/11/30232/29070-1-2019993-99445-2019-qh14.pdf.

rules.description: A damage-compensation deduction above 30% of the month’s wage after compulsory insurance and PIT.
rules.message: the damage deduction exceeds 30% of the wage after SI, HI, UI and PIT (Labour Code art.102(3)); the slip is held.
rules.authority: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.102(3): the monthly deduction may not exceed 30% of the monthly wage actually paid after compulsory social insurance, health insurance, unemployment insurance and personal income tax https://congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn/CongBaoCP/VanBan/2019/11/30232/29070-1-2019993-99445-2019-qh14.pdf.

rules.description: Overtime above 200 hours in the calendar year, or 300 in the sectors and cases Decree 145/2020 art.61 lists.
rules.when: ((has(hours.year.day_type) && has(hours.year.day_type.WORK) ? hours.year.day_type.WORK.overtime_hours : 0.0) + (has(hours.year.day_type) && has(hours.year.day_type.REST) ? hours.year.day_type.REST.worked_hours : 0.0) + (has(hours.year.day_type) && has(hours.year.day_type.OFF) ? hours.year.day_type.OFF.worked_hours : 0.0) + (has(hours.year.holiday_kind) && has(hours.year.holiday_kind.PUBLIC_HOLIDAY) ? hours.year.holiday_kind.PUBLIC_HOLIDAY.worked_hours : 0.0) + (has(hours.year.holiday_kind) && has(hours.year.holiday_kind.SUBSTITUTE) ? hours.year.holiday_kind.SUBSTITUTE.worked_hours : 0.0)) > ((has(company.facts.overtime_300h_sector) && company.facts.overtime_300h_sector == true) ? 300.0 : 200.0)
rules.message: overtime this year exceeds 200 hours (300 in the listed sectors) (Labour Code art.107(2)(b), (3)).
rules.authority: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.107(2)(b): at most 200 hours a year; art.107(3): 300 hours in the sectors and cases listed, after notifying the provincial labour authority (art.107(4); Decree 145/2020/NĐ-CP arts.61–62). Counted from hours.year: approved overtime on working days and every hour worked on rest days and holidays. https://congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn/CongBaoCP/VanBan/2019/11/30232/29070-1-2019993-99445-2019-qh14.pdf
